behavior: Values are clamped to the declared range
The value text defaults to the position in the range as a percent: with minValue 20, maxValue 100, and value 60 it reads 50%.
formatOptions with the percent style format that same percent of the range.
formatOptions without the percent style format the clamped value itself instead; a decimal style reads 60 for the same range and value.
The fill always shows the position in the range, whatever the format of the text.
Numbers are formatted for the default locale of the environment that renders them.
label is the visible name, and it is not rendered when aria-label or aria-labelledby is supplied.
With aria-label or aria-labelledby, Meter shows only its value text, so any visible label is the application's own element.
accessibility: Expose meter role, value range, value text, and accessible name
